title: pavonia ortegiana
intro: Pavonia ortegiana, commonly known as the Mexican Rose Mallow, is a species of flowering plant in the mallow family (Malvaceae). This plant is rich in medicinal properties, with numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, soothing skin irritations, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pavonia ortegiana are attributed to its ability to calm and soothe, making it a valuable treatment for conditions such as anxiety, insomnia, and skin conditions like eczema and acne. The bioactive constituents present in Pavonia ortegiana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
